newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery names Cooper high-yield sales director.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery names Cooper high-yield sales director.

text.p: Montgomery Securities on Tuesday said it has hired Ashley Cooper, formerly senior high-yield salesman at Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc's Lehman Brothers, to be a managing director and director of high yield sales at the firm.
Cooper, who joined Lehman in 1994, had previously been employed in high-yield sales at Salomon Inc's Salomon Brothers. He assumed duties at Montgomery on Tuesday.

The move follows recent additions of Peter Wilson, formerly of Bear Stearns Cos Inc's Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, and Rob Long and Lee Stern, formerly of Nomura Securities Co Ltd affiliate Nomura Securities Inc.
Montgomery said it is expanding into high-yield trading, sales, research and bridge lending to complement its existing high-yield finance department.
